title: Wake path
summary: A case's wake_path is automatic (default: starts when its stage begins, and the stage driver wakes the member's owner) or manual (its owner is woken to confirm wake_evidence before running it). Manual needs a one-line wake_evidence naming real-traffic evidence a registered read can confirm; authoring refuses wake_evidence_required, wake_evidence_without_manual_wake, wake_path_invalid or wake_evidence_not_one_line. For a member with an open manual case the stage driver sends one push_notice per open manual requirement instead of the ordinary stage wake: check the evidence with a registered read, run the member's cases if it exists, otherwise schedule the next recheck for whenever the evidence could plausibly exist (a date for time-based evidence, a sensible interval for event-based evidence) and again after every recheck that still finds none; while the requirement is open on a run executing its stage, the woken claim holder's park refuses park_recheck_required without a future scheduled wake. Notice identity is requirement, recipient session and evidence digest, so a release takeover alone sends no new notice; a changed requirement, evidence or recipient does. A takeover notice skips a holder whose moved open requirements are all manual and who holds a future scheduled wake. A notice is routed to the parked holder; actual resume depends on its surface capabilities; a holder-less member reaches the project steering seat. The steering fleet report lists each under 'waiting on manual wake' with evidence, owner and run command. A live requirement is marked with yoke qa requirement update, wake_evidence first, then wake_path. Failed-QA recovery preserves the holder and checkpoint. Queued, injected and acknowledged delivery do not prove resumed work; steering arranges operator resume when the surface lacks automatic wake. Missing automatic notice, resume or required recheck is a defect to root-cause with a subagent and file as feedback before manual recovery; report that recovery as a workaround. Manual QA evidence selection is separate from the harness wake capability.
